title: Paralog-specific intrabodies for PSD-93 and SAP102 expand the molecular toolkit to resolve excitatory synapse organization
authors: Breillat C; Renou E; Darribere M; Rimbault C; Talenton V; Ecoutin A; Daburon S; Poujol C; Choquet D; Mackereth C; Sainlos M
one_liner_zh: 该文开发针对PSD-93和SAP102的平行同源特异性内抗体工具，用于突触成像，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

A scarcity of live, paralog-specific tools has limited analysis of PSD-MAGUKs at excitatory synapses. To address this gap, we engineered small, 10 FN3-derived binders that selectively recognize PSD-93 and SAP102 -alongside an enhanced PSD-95 reagent- and converted them into regulated, gene-encoded intrabodies for endogenous imaging. Through sequence-guided selection and targeted optimization, we obtained high-specificity reagents that label their native targets in neurons with minimal perturbation and support multiplexed live-cell and advanced imaging modalities. This toolkit enables differential visualization of MAGUK paralogs at native levels and provides a practical route to dissect their distinct contributions to synapse organization and plasticity.
abstract_zh:
摘要

缺乏活体、旁系同源特异性工具限制了兴奋性突触处PSD-MAGUKs的分析。为弥补这一空白，我们设计了小型、10个FN3衍生结合物，能够选择性识别PSD-93和SAP102——同时配备增强型PSD-95试剂——并将其转化为受调控的、基因编码的内抗体，用于内源性成像。通过序列引导选择和靶向优化，我们获得了高特异性试剂，这些试剂能在神经元中以最小扰动标记其天然靶标，并支持多重活细胞成像及先进成像模式。该工具包能够在天然水平上差异可视化MAGUK旁系同源物，并提供了一种实用途径，以解析它们在突触组织和可塑性中的独特贡献。
